pages.text: The Twilight Forest is the primary $(t2)T2$() adventure dimension. Bosses, structures, and the first $(thing)Simply Swords$() uniques.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Twilight Forest is the most content-dense $(t2)T2$() dimension. Seven bosses with unique weapons, a full progression path through the forest, and some of the best $(t2)T2$() loot tables.$(br2)$(bold)Boss order:$() The forest has an internal progression. You cannot reach late zones without defeating earlier bosses. Follow the magic map or $(thing)FTB Quests$() for the intended order.

$(bold)IridescentCraft notes:$() Twilight structure chests have had diamonds removed. Tokens and $(t2)T2$() materials replace them. The forest's original loot has been preserved otherwise — Steeleaf and Ironwood armor are valid $(t2)T2$() gear choices.$(br2)$(bold)Twilight materials:$() Steeleaf, Ironwood, Fiery, Knightmetal are all valid $(t2)T2$() gear materials.

$(bold)No guide book.$() Twilight Forest is largely self-guided — each biome leads naturally to the next boss. The $(bold)Magic Map$() (crafted from a map + 4 diamonds) reveals the full dimension layout and boss locations.
